# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 62 (Bi-Vb Pc62)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc62
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 62
**Title (English, from literature):** Ordaining a breastfeeding woman
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Ute Hüsken similarly notes that Pācittiya 62, alongside Pācittiya 61, forms the direct context and rationale for the subsequent promulgation of Pācittiya 63 [Hüsken 1997].

Direct parallels to this rule are preserved in the Theravāda Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 62) and Bhikkhunī Parivāra (Pācittiya 62), as well as in Chinese Vinaya literature, including the Dharmaguptaka Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga and Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 120) and the Mahīśāsaka Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga and Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 117). An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
